    The finite-field brick count for a prescribed missing class #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_stable_bricks_of_each_degree (k : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (h : (realProjectiveClass R) P.projectiveClass ∉ TwoTerm.gVectorFanSupport R) :
    have b₀ := Module.finrank k ↑P.target.obj; have c₀ := max 1 (b₀ * Module.finrank k ↑P.source.obj); ∃ (Ω : Finset (ProjectiveClass R)), ∀ (s : ℕ), 0 < s → ∃ (B : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))), Nat.card k ^ s ≤ c₀ * s * B.card ∧ ∀ x ∈ B, ∃ (M : FGModuleCat R) (g : ProjectiveClass R), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton M = x ∧ g ∈ Ω ∧ ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsStable M ∧ IsBrick M ∧ endolength k M ≤ b₀ ∧ Module.finrank k ↑M.obj ≤ s * b₀

    If P represents a class outside the fan, then, for every extension degree s, there are at least q^s/(c₀ s) ground bricks at one fixed finite list of weights. Here b₀ is the dimension of the target and c₀ is the larger of one and the product of the ground dimensions of the two projectives.
